name: Chatway Live Chat
tagline: Manage customer conversations and support tickets with AI
description: Connect Cline to Chatway, an AI-powered live chat and customer support platform. Search and summarize conversations, draft and send customer replies, add private notes, assign agents, manage support tickets, update contacts, and search your knowledge base. Connect securely through OAuth with permissions controlled by your Chatway workspace.

install.notes: Sign in with your Chatway workspace owner or admin account using OAuth and approve the requested permissions. No API key is required.
